means.example-sentence: The coach said he was by no means satisfied with the way his baseball team played.
means.sentence-jp: コーチは, 彼の野球チームのプレーには全然満足していないと言った。

cloze.maskedText: The coach said he was ____ satisfied with the way his baseball team played.
